s: Who we are

This Policy explains how Useful Habit (the “Site”, “we”) processes personal data of its visitors. Controller: Useful Habit, contact: useful.habit@outlook.com. The Site is operated from Ukraine. Where the GDPR applies to you, we process your data in line with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and applicable national law.
Data we process

Data you provide:|name, phone number, email address and message, if you write to us or send a request form on the Site.|Data collected automatically:|IP address, device and browser type, language, pages viewed, time of visit, referrer, UTM tags and advertising click identifiers (for example gclid, fbclid);|cookies and similar technologies (section 6).|We do not ask for special categories of data, such as health data. Please do not enter such data in forms or messages.
Purposes and legal bases

We process data to:|answer your message or request (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR, steps taken at your request, or your consent under Art. 6(1)(a));|pass your request to a partner or seller of a product when you send a form containing that notice (consent, Art. 6(1)(a));|keep the Site secure and prevent fraud and automated abuse (legitimate interests, Art. 6(1)(f), balanced against your rights);|measure traffic and improve the Site, and measure advertising (consent, Art. 6(1)(a), through the cookie banner);|comply with legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c)).
Recipients

We do not sell your data. It may be shared with:|partners and sellers of products, only if you yourself sent them a request through a form; they act as independent controllers under their own policies;|service providers (hosting, email, spam protection, analytics and advertising services including Google and Meta), who process data on our behalf or under their own terms, within the scope of their services;|public authorities, when the law requires it.
International transfers

The Site is operated from Ukraine, outside the EU/EEA, and some providers are located outside the EEA (for example in the USA). Where required, transfers rely on safeguards under Chapter V GDPR, such as the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses, and we process data only to the extent needed for the purposes above.
Cookies

Necessary cookies make the Site work (for example, storing your language) and need no consent. Analytics and advertising cookies are set only after you give consent, which you can change or withdraw at any time as easily as you gave it, and in your browser settings. This follows the ePrivacy Directive 2002/58/EC as implemented in national law. Google and Meta process cookie data under their own policies.
Retention

We keep data no longer than necessary:|correspondence: up to 3 years;|request-form data: up to 12 months after the last contact, unless the law or a legal claim requires longer;|technical logs: up to 12 months;|cookies: for the periods stated in the consent settings.|After that, data is deleted or anonymised.
Your rights

Under GDPR you have the right to:|access your data (Art. 15) and receive a copy;|rectification (Art. 16);|erasure (Art. 17);|restriction of processing (Art. 18);|data portability (Art. 20);|object to processing based on legitimate interests (Art. 21);|withdraw consent at any time, without affecting earlier processing (Art. 7(3));|lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority in your country of residence, place of work or place of the alleged infringement (Art. 77).|To exercise your rights, write to useful.habit@outlook.com. We do not make decisions based solely on automated processing that produce legal effects for you.
Security
We use reasonable organisational and technical measures, including HTTPS and restricted access. No transmission over the internet is completely secure.
Minors
The Site is not intended for persons under 18 and we knowingly collect no data from them. If you believe a child has sent us data, write to us and we will delete it.
Changes
The current version is always published on this page with its date. If a change affects processing that requires consent, we will apply it only after obtaining new consent.
Contact
For data protection questions, write to useful.habit@outlook.com.
